name: openhush
description: Local, free AI noise removal for audio and video

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix ui install && cd engine && uv sync
scripts.dev:app: node desktop/build.mjs && wait-on -t 120000 http-get://localhost:3123 && cross-env OPENHUSH_DEV_URL=http://localhost:3123 electron .
scripts.start: npm run build:ui && npm run build:desktop && electron .
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:ui && npm run build:desktop && playwright test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p desktop --noEmit && npm --prefix ui exec -- tsc --noEmit -p ui
scripts.dist: npm run build:ui && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:engine && electron-builder --mac dir --publish never
scripts.pack:zip: cd dist.noindex/mac-arm64 && ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent OpenHush.app ../OpenHush-mac-arm64.zip && cd .. && shasum -a 256 OpenHush-mac-arm64.zip > OpenHush-mac-arm64.zip.sha256

author: OpenHush
